title: Listening-post fatal shooting
placementNote: Pre-July predecessor/background material; chapter coverage must be deliberately decided before publication.

paragraphs.text: The book describes two men mortally wounded by their remaining listening-post partner after approaching from behind. Names, date and precise company are unstated; battalion attribution from surrounding McPartlin passage remains a review issue.

notes: Source references support the whole proposal; normalized OCR is not a human correction.
No confirmed participant assignment until corroborated. The surrounding discussion covers both infantry battalions.
